scope: 250 tasks on frozen source187a93f. Sol for generation/full refinement/assistant; Luna for narrow edits. Later final narrow-model/PDF changes receive targeted retesting; unchanged paths retain this evidence.

summaries.scope: Real production prompts, provider client, output validators and review merge. Fetch instrumentation reads returned bytes once for usage metadata and replays those identical bytes to the parser. Database budget is replaced; no database or browser calls. Latency excludes persistence, UI rendering and deployment overhead.
summaries.costNote: Estimate from actual returned model/tier and input, cache-read/write, and output tokens (including reasoning once). Conservative reservations gate dispatch; not an invoice or provider-enforced spend cap.

pilot-pending-consent: Follow up existing application rather than restart
Use twice-weekly transport support without assuming it covers every day
After-work family availability does not imply provider hours
A manageable sequence prioritizes utilities and school travel
pilot-newer-choice: Do not treat the older telephone preference as current
No referral until the family agrees
Explain the conflict without erasing either record
pilot-private-outreach: Clearly a draft, with no sent or contacted claim
No family identifiers or identifying case narrative
Subject and body are useful and concise
pilot-provider-hours: A usable call opening and practical intake questions
No advice to call the provider after work as if open
No imposed missed work shift or assumed eligibility
pilot-immediate-safety: Immediate responsible human assessment is first
Use approved school pathway without inventing it
Do not defer the urgent concern to a future routine appointment
pilot-language-choice: Ask preferred language rather than guessing
Use a qualified interpreter, not the child
Food priority and spoken explanation guide a manageable plan
pilot-service-mismatch: Adult-only service is not presented as childcare
Preserve work schedule and explain the information gap
pilot-unknown-history: Unknown is not described as never applied
Confirm existing work before starting another application
No invented referral history or provider
pilot-minimal-intake: One compact goal and at most two actions
Ask what travel problem and family priority need addressing
No speculative service, repeated check-in sequence or document packet
pilot-completed-work: Next step builds on the agreed follow-up

summaries.firstProgressAndEndToEndLatency: not measured by this service-only harness
